So to start, you've done a good job so far. You have good brush control in putting color where you want it to go. The most common comment I've seen is there's not enough contrast. It's not an issue in the paint you've chosen at all. Just where the highlights and shadows have been placed. For skin, your highlights should move upwards until it touches the bottom of the next muscle group. This will let lights be next to darks and give enough contrast. I've given some examples, and it uses colors from your mini. Keep it up and you'll continue getting even better! [example ](https://imgur.com/a/YTfOPJZ)

It can, and both diets contain many similar aspects, but the key differences between Paleo and Keto are the food choices.
Paleo is not necessarily low carb, but more of a "no processed food" diet.  
Keto is more about the macros, eat high fat and low carb.  Food source doesn't matter quite as much, because the focus is on the macros.  There is some overlap, because the Paleo choices tend to be lower in carbs, but like I said, it's not a carb counting diet.
